title: The Science Behind Nextherapy
summary: Nextherapy's interventions have a strong focus on intensity, repetition, and specificity, often involving the use of robotics and technologies to optimally activate activity-dependent brain plasticity, which can have significantly positive effects on recovery from brain damage.

key_findings.description: Intensive programs with 25 to 30 therapy hours per week have shown improvements that are twice as high as other interventions with lower intensity.
